overview.description: Forty-One Exchange (often known simply as '41' in Southeast Asia and Indonesia) is a high-speed draw-and-discard game centered on set collection. Unlike most card games where high cards are balanced by low ones, every player in 41 is chasing the exact same perfection: a hand of four cards of the same suit that totals exactly 41 points. It is a game of probability and speed, where players must quickly pivot their strategy as the cards they need are snatched up by opponents.

history.origins: While its exact origins are undocumented, Forty-One Exchange is a staple of Indonesian social culture (known locally as 'Main Kartu 41'). it is primarily played in informal settings like schools, community centers, and local cafes as a fast-paced gambling or social game.
timeline: Mid-20th Century: Gains widespread popularity across the Indonesian archipelago.
1990s: Becomes a popular 'icebreaker' game in Southeast Asian corporate and social events.
Present: Frequently featured in mobile card game apps across Asia.

setup.dealing: Each player is dealt 4 cards. The remaining deck is placed in the center as a draw pile.

rules.objective: Collect 4 cards of the same suit that sum to 41, or have the highest total suit-score when the deck runs out.
rules.gameplay:
1. Turns: Players take turns clockwise.
2. Draw: A player draws one card from either the stock or the discard pile.
3. Discard: After drawing, the player MUST discard one card, maintaining a total of 4 in their hand.
4. Ending: The game ends immediately if a player reaches 41 points. Otherwise, it ends when the stock is empty.
keyRules: The 41 Rule: A perfect hand consists of an Ace (11) and three 10-value cards (K, Q, J, 10).
Discard Awareness: You cannot draw a card and then immediately discard that same card.
Winning condition: Collect 4 cards of the same suit that sum to 41, or have the highest total suit-score when the deck runs out.

strategy.basic: Commit early. If you start with two Hearts, keep those Hearts and discard anything else. Changing suits mid-game is usually a recipe for defeat.
strategy.intermediate: Watch the Discards: If you see your opponent discarding Diamonds, that means Diamonds are 'safe' for you to build as they won't be competing for the cards you need.
strategy.advanced: The Ace Bait: If you hold an Ace of a suit you aren't using, hold onto it as long as possible. This 'chokes' the game for whoever is trying to build that suit, potentially forcing them to settle for a lower score.
tips: Aces are the heart of the game. If you don't have an Ace, your maximum score is only 30 (three 10s). You must get an Ace to win.
If the deck is getting low and no one has hit 41, stop trying for perfection and focus on having the highest total in ANY suit.

variations.noVariationsReason: Sources describe only the standard form; no regional or rule variations documented for Main Kartu 41.

difficulty.easy: Changes suits constantly; discards Aces; doesn't track what opponents are picking up.
difficulty.medium: Picks a suit and sticks to it; prioritizes picking up Aces from the discard pile.
difficulty.hard: Anticipates which suit each opponent is building; holds onto key cards (like Aces) to block others even if they don't help its own hand; calculates the exact probability of hitting 41 based on the remaining deck.

considerations: AI must maintain a 'Target Suit' variable and weight discards based on how much they help opponents versus hurting itself.

deal.description: Dealer distributes 4 cards to each player and sets up stock and discard piles.

play_card.reason: Game does not involve card play.

draw.description: Draw one card from the stock or from the top of the discard pile.
draw.constraints: Must draw at start of turn. Player may choose stock or discard pile.

discard.description: Discard one card to the discard pile after drawing. Hand returns to 4 cards.
discard.constraints: Mandatory after drawing. Cannot discard the card you just drew (unless house rule allows).

go_out.reason: Game has no going out mechanic.

drawSources.notes: Only the top card of the discard pile may be drawn.

edgeCases.text: Player cannot discard the card they just drew in the same turn unless house rules allow.

engine.handRankingSystem: Suit point total only; no poker hands. Highest total in a single suit wins; four cards of one suit totaling 41 wins immediately.
engine.rankingSystem: Suit-based point totals (highest single suit = winner or 41 = immediate win)
engine.deckDescription: One full deck of 52 cards using French suits (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades) and standard ranks from ace through king, with no jokers.
engine.suitDescription: French suits: hearts (cœurs), diamonds (carreaux), clubs (trèfles), and spades (piques). Each suit has thirteen cards from ace through king.
engine.rankDescription: Standard ranking for a 52-card deck: ace (high or low by context), king, queen, jack, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2. Thirteen cards per suit.
engine.dealPattern: 4 cards per player; rest forms stock pile

synthesis.shortDescription: A fast-paced Southeast Asian set-collection game where players race to gather four cards of the same suit totaling exactly 41 points.

prompts.human: Welcome to Forty-One Exchange, the fast Indonesian card game. Build a hand of four cards from the same suit that totals 41 points. On your turn, draw from the stock or discard pile, then discard one card. First to reach 41 wins immediately. If the deck runs out, highest suit total wins.
prompts.ai: Game: Forty-One Exchange (Set collection / Draw-Discard). Deal: 4 cards per player; stock and discard piles setup. Turn: Draw 1 card (stock or discard), then discard 1 card (maintaining 4-card hand). Card values: Ace=11, K/Q/J=10, 2-10=face value. Win condition: First to get 4 cards of same suit totaling exactly 41 points wins immediately. If stock exhausted: highest single-suit total wins. Strategy: Lock into one suit early; track opponent discard patterns; hold Aces and 10-value cards.

scoring.description: Players collect cards of the same suit totaling exactly 41 points. High suit-score wins if deck runs out.
scoring.winCondition: First player to collect 4 cards of the same suit summing to exactly 41 points wins immediately. If deck empties, highest suit-total wins.
